run_mjx_viewer: run the MJX MuJoCo viewer with a specified MJCF model path and JAX or Warp backend
launch_passive_viewer: launch a passive MuJoCo viewer with key callback support for pausing simulation
jit_compile_step_fn: JIT-compile the MJX physics step function for accelerated simulation performance
convert_model_to_jax: convert a MuJoCo MjModel and MjData to JAX-compatible MJX model and data structures
sync_mjx_to_mujoco: copy MJX simulation data back into native MuJoCo MjData for viewer rendering
